first_line: Zion, at your shining gates
Prepare the royal highway
O Lord, of Light, our only hope of glory
Lo, he comes with clouds descending
The night will soon be ending
A stable lamp is lighted
Peace came to earth at last that chosen night
Now greet the swiftly changing year
Christ, your footprints through the desert
Jesus, once with sinners numbered
Jesus has come and brings pleasure eternal
tune: JESUS IST KOMMEN, GRUND EWIGER FREUDE

first_line: Jesus, take us to the mountain
In silent pain th' eternal Son
The Lamb, the Lamb
What grace is this!
No tramp of soldiers' marching feet
tune: NO TRAMP OF SOLDIERS’ MARCHING FEET

first_line: When you woke that Thursday morning
Rest, O Christ, from all your labor
tune: O MEIN JESU, ICH MUSS STERBEN

first_line: Christ has arisen, alleluia
Christ Jesus lay in death's strong bonds
If Christ had not been raised from death
Scatter the darkness, break the gloom
Holy Spirit, the dove sent from heaven
Voices raised to you we offer
The God of love, in heav'n above
Christ, the Lord of hosts unshaken
There is a higher throne
Jerusalem the golden
There is a blessed home beyond this land of woe
Multitudes, clothed in white robes
The King will come at age's end
The Lord is the strength of our lives
Rejoice in God! Let trumpets sound
When in our music God is glorified
Speak, O Lord, as we come to you
All Christians who have been baptized
God's own child, I gladly say it
In hopelessness and near despair
Baptismal waters cover me
Draw near and take the body of our Lord
I am the word that spoke and light was made
What is this bread?
O gracious Lord, I firmly am believing
As when the shepherd calls his sheep
May the peace of God our heav'nly Father
You, Lord, are both Lamb and Shepherd
There is a Redeemer
Your only Son, no sin to hide
The love of Christ, who died for me
Christ,t he Word of God incarnate
Word of God, when all was silent
In Christ alone my hope is found
Father, God of grace, you knew us
The tree of life with ev'ry good
Your kingdom, O God, is my glorious treasure
We walk by faith and not by sight
What do you gain from all your worry
Blest are they, the poor in spirit
In God's house there are many places
tune: DO NOT LET YOUR HEARTS BE TROUBLED

first_line: When peace like a river attendeth my way
We were buried with him into death
Consider how the birds above
Jesus sat with his disciples
There is a time for ev'rything
Day by day, your mercies, Lord, attend me
The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want
There is one thing I ask of the Lord
How firm a foundation, O saints of the Lord
Lord, of all hopefulness, Lord of all joy
O Christ, who called the Twelve
I want to walk as a child of the light
When Jesus came from Nazareth
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
Church of God, elect and glorious
For builders bold whose vision pure
Sing with all the saints in glory
Now let us all, in hymns of praise, bear witness with one voice
How shall they hear who have not heard
I sing as I arise today
Stay with us till night has come
I lie, O Lord, within your care
tune: ICH LIEGE, HERR, IN DEINER HUT

first_line: Lord support us all day long
Stay with us, Lord, the sun descends
O gracious Lord, with love draw near
O Lord, of nations, hear our prayer
The Lord is our strength
To the One who sits on the throne
tune: [To the One who sits on the throne]

first_line: Blessed are they who washed their robes
tune: [Blessed are they who washed their robes]
